deliveries.title: Deliveries
deliveries.subtitle: {production}'s notes: what goes out, what comes back and in what shape.

deliveries.emptyBody: Open an outbound note to hand props over, or a return note to collect them.

deliveries.verifyFailed: The verification could not be changed.
deliveries.removeFailed: The piece could not be removed.
deliveries.completeBodyOut: All {count} items will be marked delivered. This is a real inventory change.
deliveries.completeBodyIn: All {count} items will be left in the state their line declared.
deliveries.signatureIsLater: No signature is needed to close: it closes on the verified pieces and the signature is collected afterwards.
deliveries.cancelKeepsItems: The items do not move: they never went out.
deliveries.deleteCascadeReturns: Items this note left delivered go back to available
deliveries.signBody: You are the one handing over: your session says so. Who receives is typed in, because they may have no account.
deliveries.signIsFinal: A recorded signature cannot be modified. That is what makes it evidence.
deliveries.signFailed: The signature could not be recorded.
deliveries.receiverNameHint: Their name, as they want it to appear on the note.
deliveries.strokeHint: Sign here with your finger or a stylus
deliveries.strokeOptional: Strokes are optional: on a set people sign on paper, and the name and date are already recorded.
deliveries.strokeFailed: The stroke could not be saved. You can record the signature without it: the note will still say who received and when.
deliveries.unsignedClosed: Not signed. The note closed on its verified pieces; the signature can arrive later.
deliveries.unsignedOpen: Not signed. Signing happens once the note is closed.
